claim: The 440 completely SHA-verified original named fpw_* embedded RS source payloads have a bounded 12-byte first-entry source window at embedded positions +64..+75. All 440 original GGM-name/PathID-indexed window values are enumerated by a reproducible digest SHA256 93abc0c9dc1ff9c90490637d222b414615c4ec2c28951f51c098285389f2bf4c and concatenated original 5280 source bytes SHA256 c2cea392b5a818ceaa850d26be900d62cec321bcd571ceb58fe468ef76935fb3; 305 distinct 12-byte windows. Of 79 source-name suffix sibling comparisons in 65 families, 75 pairs have identical full first 12 bytes; only fpw_2006_0/_1, fpw_2006_0/_2, fpw_2011_0/_1 and fpw_6053_0/_1 differ within +64..+75, solely at original offsets +70/+72/+73 as indexed. Matching originally verified DLL-001 SkillDataMan.ParseRSFData IL first-entry read sequence conditionally reads +64..70 into nine source-named field targets together with +74..75, while advancing without a byte-to-field read at +71..73. The original indexed byte distributions and exact prior original DLL metadata field map are checked without asserting that the 440 TextAssets were loaded, parsed, or played in the retail runtime.
